title: Lovely Runner
hook: How does Lovely Runner end? The final timeline, the watch that erases their first meeting, and whether Sun-jae and Sol find each other again, explained.

sections.heading: Why Sol keeps travelling back
sections.body: In 2022, Im Sol is a devoted Eclipse fan confined to a wheelchair after a 2008 accident, while her idol Ryu Sun-jae is the band's former swimmer turned singer. When Sun-jae dies by suicide in late 2022, Sol is hurled back to June 2008, when both are nineteen-year-old high schoolers. She learns Sun-jae fell for her years earlier after she once handed him an umbrella in the rain. Armed with that knowledge, Sol vows to rewrite both their fates, repeatedly jumping between timelines to stop his death and her own paralysing accident before they can ever happen.

sections.heading: The kidnapping and Young-soo
sections.body: Across her attempts, Sol traces the root of the tragedy to taxi driver Kim Young-soo, whose crime is what leaves her paralysed in the original timeline. In the final timeline she manages to prevent that attack, reporting Young-soo to the police with specific identifying details so he is caught before he can hurt her. Saving herself, however, does not save Sun-jae. The series does not let her have both: even with Young-soo exposed, Sol is unable to keep Sun-jae alive, and he is stabbed to death by Young-soo, the same man whose violence had always shadowed her story.

sections.heading: The watch erases their first meeting
sections.body: Faced with a Sun-jae who keeps dying, Sol makes the hardest choice the show offers. She uses the magical watch that has powered her time jumps to erase their very first meeting, the umbrella in the rain, undoing the love that doomed him. The cost is total: in the new timeline Sun-jae survives, but he has no memory of Sol at all. She trades the relationship itself for his life, accepting a world where the person she saved will not know who she is or what she sacrificed to keep him breathing.

sections.heading: 2023 and the screenplay reunion
sections.body: The rewritten world lands in 2023, and it is kinder. Sol can walk and has become a successful film director, while Sun-jae has grown into a famous actor with no recollection of their past lives. Their paths cross again through her work: Sol writes a screenplay that dramatises their time-crossed romance, and when Sun-jae reads it he is moved to tears by a story he does not consciously remember living. He agrees to star in her film adaptation, and the two reconnect, the feeling resurfacing even though the memories were wiped clean.

final_image: Sun-jae, cast in Sol's film of their own erased romance, reaches her again as the rewritten timeline lets the two of them begin once more without the memory of everything she undid.

lingering_questions.q: Does Sun-jae die at the end of Lovely Runner?
lingering_questions.a: In the final timeline he is stabbed to death by Young-soo, so Sol uses the watch to erase their first meeting. That rewrite saves his life, and in 2023 he is alive and working as an actor, though without memory of her.

lingering_questions.q: Do Sun-jae and Sol end up together?
lingering_questions.a: Yes, in the rewritten 2023 timeline. He has no memory of their shared past, but reading Sol's screenplay about their romance moves him to tears, he agrees to star in her film, and the two reconnect.
